title: Assorted Pebbles
description: Dig up Pebbles from the ground with this fully customizable mod!
body:
**What does this mod do?**

This mod adds pebbles to the game!

- ![Stone Pebble](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/daf55920fe07dbe8d0cccc72390e32a6d882037b_0.webp)Stone Pebble
- ![Andesite Pebble](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fb672faa9f0cfd142921e975cd6acb918fe6b3dd_0.webp)Andesite Pebble
- ![Diorite Pebble](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/05dcae1824d7d0bde254fdef0319878b96b9c5b1_0.webp)Diorite Pebble
- ![Granite Pebble](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0333e2426cf1f449ff4348453f29b8785617f7cb_0.webp)Granite Pebble
- ![Deepslate Pebble](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/59043ccd4585c57833b61b3235e17662fb03f93f_0.webp)Deepslate Pebble
- ![Flint Shard](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0307a09e8076ba51b04afef09fac7355993c0f11_0.webp)Flint Shard

These items can be collected by Shift + Right Clicking Dirt! (Flint comes from Gravel)
![Pebbles Spawned by Shift + Right Clicking](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f84e2f7994c66ef079815d08ff4b175988617c0.png)

**What are Pebbles good for?**

Pebbles can be combined into their respective block in a 4x4 Crafting Grid.

![Granite Pebble to Granite crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d01d4a5ae3297c0a39a0fc4f0071af34cad469d8.png)

**Great for Challenge Modpacks!**

Additionally, this mod is completely customizable through its config file! You can set it up so that absolutely any item can drop from any block you want. You aren't limited to just one or two loot tables either. Feel free to create as many as you need!

**The default config file:**

```
["Assorted Pebbles Config"]
	#How many game ticks between each pebble drop while holding Shift + Right-Click.
	# Default: 5
	# Range: 1 ~ 100
	tickCooldown = 5
	#Configure your loot pools as individual block entries.
	#You can create as many as you want!
	#Format:
	#  [ "target_block_or_tag",
	#      """\
	#      "item1:chance1,
	#      item2:chance2,
	#      etc"
	#      """
	#  ],
	lootPools = [
["#minecraft:dirt",
       """\
       assortedpebbles:stone_pebble:0.45, 
       assortedpebbles:andesite_pebble:0.12, 
       assortedpebbles:diorite_pebble:0.12, 
       assortedpebbles:granite_pebble:0.12, 
       assortedpebbles:deepslate_pebble:0.05
       """
],
["minecraft:gravel",
       """\
       assortedpebbles:flint_shard:0.1, 
       minecraft:flint:0.02
       """
]]

```
